description: This file contains functions and types for creating and saving bookings, including handling event details, form responses, and database transactions within a booking system.

methods.name: updateEventDetails
methods.description: Updates the event's description and location based on the original rescheduled booking.

methods.name: getAssociatedBookingForFormResponse
methods.description: Fetches the associated booking UID for a given form response ID from the database.

methods.name: _createBooking
methods.description: Main function to create a new booking, handle form response associations, and save to database.

methods.name: saveBooking
methods.description: Saves the booking data to the database, handling related updates and transactions.

methods.name: getEventTypeRel
methods.description: Returns the Prisma relation object for an event type ID.

methods.name: getAttendeesData
methods.description: Generates attendee data array including team members and their locales.

methods.name: buildNewBookingData
methods.description: Constructs the data object for creating a new booking, including handling rescheduling and form responses.

methods.name: getReroutingFormResponseUpdateData
methods.description: Prepares update data for rerouting form responses if applicable.
